reasoning_trace.value: The ISAC-OF system uses a periodic linear frequency modulation (LFM) light as the optical carrier and sensing probe. The LFM optical carrier is generated with single-sideband (SSB) modulation and is used to carry a 4-level pulse amplitude-modulation (PAM4) signal. The system uses the same wavelength channel for simultaneous data transmission and distributed vibration sensing.
